snippet.title: VHS Tapes // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818670/VHS_Tapes

VHS Tapes is a 1-4 player, online co-op horror. Experience a collection of mysterious video tapes, each one containing completely different stories, locations, puzzles and nightmares to endure. INSERT. PRESS PLAY.

👥 Players: Single Player, Online Co-op
🛠️ Developer: DogHat Games
📚 Publisher: DogHat Games
📅 Release Date: Oct 8, 2026 to Early Access
🎯 Genre: Action, Adventure, Indie, Early Access

AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:
This game utilises AI for generating marketing materials and in-game paintings.

Mature Content Description
The developers describe the content like this:
VHS Tapes is a horror game that shows depictions of violence between enemies and the players. There is some gore within the environments and the player/enemy interaction but it is not focused on heavily.
Players sensitive to violence, gore, jump-scares and horror content should potentially avoid this game.
